description: This is a shell script used for managing network interface configurations within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions for finding, fixing, scanning, preparing, and setting up network interfaces, utilizing ubus and JSON utilities.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds the network interface configuration matching a device name.

methods.name: unbridge
methods.description: Placeholder function, does nothing in its current form.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call and loads returned JSON data.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface configuration, especially for bridge types.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies fixup to all interfaces.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface.

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Sets sysctl parameters or retrieves their values.
